channel.title: MindExtract
channel.description: MindExtract. Download and transcribe video from anywhere.

item.title: Version 3.0.2
item.description:
MindExtract 3.0.2

  • Saved videos open in QuickTime, even 4K and full size Instagram reels. MindExtract converts them on your Mac when needed.
  • Pick the size right on the Save button, up to 8K, or keep the original file, or just the audio.
  • TikTok transcripts use what people say, not the background song.
  • Long videos and podcasts save and transcribe reliably, and your Mac stays awake while they do.
  • Subtitles are built into the video, and cancelled saves leave nothing behind.
  • Clearer messages for live streams, private posts and sites that need you to sign in.
